## How to cite

If you use this application in your research, please cite:

::: callout-note
Psychogyiopoulos, A., Smits, N., Booij, G. J., & van der Ark, L. A. (2026).
*Implementing computerized adaptive testing in Qualtrics: Why, how, and an
online tutorial for researchers* [Manuscript submitted for publication].
:::

<details>
<summary>BibTeX</summary>

```bibtex
@unpublished{Psychogyiopoulos_etal_2026_Qualtrics,
  author   = {Psychogyiopoulos, Anastasios and Smits, Niels and Booij, Goan J. and {van der Ark}, L. Andries},
  date     = {2026},
  title    = {Implementing Computerized Adaptive Testing in {Qualtrics}},
  subtitle = {Why, How, and an Online Tutorial for Researchers},
  pubstate = {submitted},
```

</details>

## Acknowledgements

This application is built on the R packages **mirt** [@Chalmers_2012_mirt]
and **mirtCAT** [@Chalmers_2016_mirtCAT], which provide the item response
theory estimation and adaptive testing engine behind it. We thank their
author for making them openly available.
